entries.title: Reus sine mente: Criminal Responsibility for Artificial Intelligence Systems
entries.summary: Examines criminal responsibility when autonomous AI commits crimes. Argues that as AI autonomy increases, holding developers liable becomes impossible, and the AI's own actions sever causal links. Contends law must adapt to accelerating AI development.

entries.title: It will soon be too late to regulate use of autonomous weapons, warns Red Cross
entries.summary: Reports Red Cross warning that regulating autonomous weapons use will soon become impossible if action is not taken immediately.

entries.title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
entries.summary: UN diplomats in Geneva failed to agree binding rules on autonomous weapons. After fruitless negotiations, countries agreed only to 'start discussing options.' Red Cross, UN secretary-general and Pope Leo had urged binding rules within one year.

entries.title: The FBI and USDA were reportedly hacked
entries.summary: FBI and USDA were hacked. FBI attack targeted National Crime Information Center used by law enforcement to share warrants and missing persons data—the agency's second attack in months. USDA payments database reportedly compromised. President Trump confirmed the FBI hack.

entries.title: Passive 'ghost' radar can detect airborne threats without revealing its own position
entries.summary: Passive radar system detects airborne threats without revealing its own position. Technology piggybacks off TV and mobile signals; can be deployed in vehicles like SUVs.

entries.title: Protesters storm Meta offices in India
entries.summary: Congress party protesters stormed Meta offices in Delhi demanding account restoration. Party alleges Meta censors speech disagreeing with Prime Minister Modi's BJP; some accounts were restored Friday, though party warns of further protests.

entries.title: Banks Have Had It Up to Here With Your AI Agent
entries.summary: Major US banks ban third-party AI agents from accessing customer accounts. Financial institutions warn that customers bear full responsibility for any costly errors made by bots.
